review.brief:
Review RM68-gateway-add-km-per-gallon-tile (module gateway, plus leader-owned cmd/web/main.go and root README.md). Read the diff of commit 1919824 (git show 1919824) - not the whole module.
Validate:
1. Module boundaries: gateway reads internal/reference ONLY through reference.Reader; no import of internal/reference/db; no HTML outside internal/gateway.
2. design.md D1-D6 and roadmap D5, D6, D8-D13: price read in the handler (D1); join by monthKey (D2); a month counts only with a resolved price AND cost > 0, its distance excluded too (D3); plain ratio of sums (D4); no trend pair, previous period passes nil (D5); price read failure logs and hides only this tile (D6); price never rendered; nothing stored; no currency check.
3. Worked-example contract in design.md: Aug 900 km/80000 at 16000 + Oct 1100 km/97986 at 16331 -> "181.8 km/gal"; all-excluded -> KmPerGallon == "" and tile not rendered. Check by reading the code.
4. Conventions: i18n key with ES and EN; ui.StatTile reuse, no new pattern; semantic classes only; code comments carry no decision/roadmap/ticket IDs and no design.md pointers.
5. Docs: gateway AGENTS.md, both KB guides (kkpa/context/input-port/analytics/vehicle-stats.md, kkpa/context/entities/fuel-price/guide.md), README dependency graph, all accurate against the code.
6. Performance-Profile: one extra PricesForMonths query per render, none for the previous period.
7. Anti-gaming: tasks.md tasks unchanged except checkboxes; no weakened criteria; no self-approved status.
No database objects in this change (no DB gate). Unit tests are excluded by decision (roadmap D13) - absence of new tests is NOT a finding.
Signals: assistant-run = go build, go vet, gofmt -l, make lint (0 issues), make ui-guard, i18n-guard, money-guard, tz-guard, boundary-guard, theme-guard (all pass). User-reported = make test passed. make test-with-db not reported (leader decision D3).
Test-Execution-Policy and the B2 writing rule apply verbatim (see dispatch).
